response.justification: Bogdan brings 14+ years of hands-on software development with genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth — he authored a D test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built CI/CD and device-orchestration infrastructure, and worked on a C IDE at National Instruments. That maps well to the engineering productivity focus. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position, and the resume shows no evidence of the required 2 years of people management or 3 years of formal technical leadership: titles are Senior/Staff individual contributor, and there is no mention of direct reports, performance reviews, hiring, or roadmap ownership for a team. Mobile-platform depth is also thin (one stint taking over iOS/tvOS apps in 2015). He could be a strong senior IC or a first-time manager candidate, but he does not currently meet the stated management minimums.
strengths: Deep, demonstrable developer-tooling and test-infrastructure work (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, Selenium curriculum)
14+ years across web, mobile, desktop and embedded; broad system design exposure
Strong mentoring/teaching signal via workshops, dojos, conference talks and open-source leadership
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports (hard requirement)
No formal technical lead / staff-plus leadership scope with roadmap ownership evidenced
Limited and dated mobile-platform ecosystem experience

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
